info.title: Tikway Anthropic Messages API
info.description: Anthropic Messages-compatible chat API through the Tikway gateway.

model.description: The Claude model ID used to generate the message, for example claude-opus-5.

max_tokens.description: The maximum number of tokens to generate content. The model can be stopped before reaching the upper limit; set to 0 to only warm up the prompt cache without generating a reply.

messages.description: Enter the conversation message. The model works in user and assistant turns; consecutive messages with the same role will be merged. If there is no system role, please use the top-level system for system prompt words.

role.description: Message role. When the last item is assistant , the model will continue to be generated from its content.

content.description: Message content. A string is equivalent to an array containing only one text block.

text.description: text The text of the content block.

id.description: The unique call ID of the tool_use content block.

name.description: tool_use The name of the tool called.

tool_use_id.description: The tool_use ID that tool_result responds to.

content.description: The result content of tool_result can be a string or an array of content blocks.

is_error.description: Whether tool_result indicates a tool execution error.

thinking.description: The thinking content returned by the previous response; this must remain intact when passed back.

signature.description: Signature of the thinking content block; must remain intact on postback.

data.description: Encrypted data for redacted_thinking; must be returned intact.

system.description: System prompt word. The Messages API does not support system role messages, this field should be used.

stream.description: Whether to stream message events as Server-Sent Events.

stop_sequences.description: Customize stop sequence; model generation stops when it reaches any sequence.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature. Higher values ​​make the output more random; usually adjusted with top_p, top_k.

top_k.description: The number of candidate tokens with the highest probability retained during each sampling step.

thinking.description: Extended thinking configuration. Optional enabled, adaptive, disabled, or passed in null. When think is enabled, think tokens count toward max_tokens.

budget_tokens.description: Think about the token budget, which must be less than max_tokens.

block_binding.description: How to handle when the returned thought block does not pass the dialog prefix check; omitted, null or empty objects use the default behavior.

prefix_mismatch_behavior.description: error will return 400; drop_block will remove unmatched think blocks.

display.description: Think about how the content is presented; omitted will hide the content but retain the signature for multiple rounds of conversation.

tools.description: A tool definition that can be called by Claude.

input_schema.description: JSON Schema of tool input parameters.

type.description: Tool type; custom tools are usually custom or omitted.

tool_choice.description: Controls whether and how Claude selects tools.

name.description: The name of the tool that is forced to be called when type is tool.

disable_parallel_tool_use.description: Whether to disable parallel tool calls.

container.description: Code execution container configuration or container ID.

compaction.description: Anthropic conversation compaction. Non-null values cannot be combined with context_management.

get.description:
Return the same full callable model catalog as GET /v1/models across providers and text, image, video, audio, embedding, and decision models. No implicit protocol filtering is applied. The native response envelope and pagination remain available; provider, mode, and type filters are explicit.

Each model includes aliases, architecture, capabilities.endpoints, capabilities.parameters, and capabilities.reasoning_efforts, matching the OpenAI list. Merge common with the endpoint parameter array for its complete parameter set. Catalog inclusion does not imply support for generation through this protocol; use capabilities.endpoints.

GET /v1/models with anthropic-version also returns this presentation.

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: Filter by the exact provider namespace in the model ID, for example google. Omit to include all providers.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Filter by mode: chat, image_generation, video_generation, embedding, transcription, audio_generation, decision, or music_generation. Comma-separated or repeated values are combined with OR.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Filter by type: text, image, video, music, embedding, audio, or decision. Comma-separated or repeated values are supported; provider, mode, and type filters intersect.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size, default 20, maximum 1000. Follow has_more and last_id to retrieve the full catalog.

parameters.name: after_id
parameters.description: Continue after this model ID, normally the previous last_id. Mutually exclusive with before_id.

parameters.name: before_id
parameters.description: Retrieve the preceding page. Mutually exclusive with after_id.

200.description: One page of the full catalog with platform model metadata.

id.description: Full platform model ID, preserving any provider namespace.

created_at.description: 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z when no release date is configured.

supported_parameters.description: Native Anthropic parameter names; empty if no Anthropic profile exists.

aliases.description: Configured model aliases; an empty array is returned when none are configured.

architecture.description: Input and output modalities derived from platform configuration and callable endpoints.

reasoning_efforts.description: Reasoning effort values from actual endpoint parameter profiles; an empty array when no levels are configured.

parameters.description: common contains parameters shared by all callable endpoints; each endpoint path contains only additional parameters. Combine both arrays for its full parameter set. A single-endpoint model may list every parameter in common.

capabilities.description: Configured callable endpoints, parameter groups, and reasoning efforts; shared across all catalog presentations.

catalog_metadata.summary: Video models are included in the catalog
